Environmental changes are integrated into the dynamic knowledge graph. For RoboMemory, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of spatial knowledge graph.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (spatial knowledge graph) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, fixed-rule correction of stored state, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
